target_claim: For E:x^2/a^2+y^2/b^2=1, a>b>0, c^2=a^2-b^2, a strict proper nested confocal elliptical caustic and any coprime closed odd least-period N>=3 billiard orbit, let Q_i be intersections of consecutive tangents to E at original orbit vertices. Unit-invert Q_i separately about original foci (+c,0),(-c,0), join inverted vertices by straight segments in orbit order, and take signed shoelace areas B_+,B_-. Claim: B_+ B_- is phase independent.

allowed_domain.area: signed shoelace on straight inverse-vertex joins

excluded_or_distinct: inversion of whole edges as circles
independent_falsification_mechanism: Physically distinct falsification family: derive tangent intersections by raw 2x2 line solving from independently generated ellipse billiard vertices; check caustic tangency/reflection/closure geometrically; invert those raw intersections with Euclidean squared distances; take shoelace directly. Independently derive symbolic coordinate, distance, and edge determinant identities and try normalization, swapped outer axes, modulus-versus-parameter, orientation, focus/vertex substitutions, short odd periods, primitive stars, even counterexamples, repeats and limiting cases. Numerical diagnostics are not universal proof.
read_before_freeze: parent task and user research policy only; no candidate proof, prior review or verdict read
estimate_scope: completion of this independent physical geometry audit, not whole research discovery or publication acceptance
